The new code selects efficiency and weights using the flow variable’s snapshots and converts ordinary snapshot-indexed data to the model’s representation. However, `_model_snapshot_array` assumes every efficiency DataFrame has a single component-name column index; stochastic networks can have `(scenario, name)` MultiIndex columns, for which `values.columns.rename("name")` fails rather than preserving the scenario dimension. Thus the guarantee does not hold for every network.
